description: This file defines the TwigTransTokenParser class for Drupal, which parses 'trans' tags in Twig templates to generate an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) for translation purposes.

classes.name: TwigTransTokenParser
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractTokenParser to parse 'trans' tags in Twig templates for Drupal.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'trans' token and constructs a TwigNodeTrans object representing the translation block.

methods.name: decideForFork
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates a 'plural' switch or end of 'trans' block.

methods.name: decideForEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates the end of a 'trans' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'trans' that this parser handles.

methods.name: checkTransString
methods.description: Validates that the parsed nodes contain only allowed types for translation.
